profile.ja: 五車学園の学生対魔忍。ふうま宗家の現当主にして、ふうま一門を支配する頭目衆“ふうま八将”筆頭。『小太郎』は本名では無く、当主が代々継承する名である。邪眼使いを輩出するふうま本流の血統ながら、本人は生まれつき右目が開かず、邪眼の力に覚醒していない。そのため一部の者からは“当主失格の目抜け”と侮蔑されていた。父・弾正は政府に与するのをよしとせず井河や甲河らと対立、五車に反乱を起こしたが若きアサギや朧に敗れ死亡した。当時まだ幼子だった主人公は、その後同じく幼くしてふうま宗家の後見人となった姉・時子に育てられた。新たな当主である主人公を引き立ててふうま家の再興を目指す時子であるが、主人公自身はどこ吹く風、自由気ままに生きている。腹違いの姉であり育ての親であり、後見人として全財産を管理する時子に対して主人公は一切頭が上がらず、彼女を怒らせる事を何よりの恐怖としている。趣味は五車学園に秘蔵されている古書を読み漁る事で、授業をサボってはお気に入りの木陰で読書に耽っていた。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin student at Gosha Academy, the current head of the Fuuma family and the leader of the Fuuma clan's ruling group, the "Fuuma Eight Generals". "Kotaro" is not her real name, but a name that has been passed down through the generations of heads. Although she is from the main Fuuma family line, which is known for producing evil eye users, she was born with her right eye closed and has not awakened to the power of the evil eye. For this reason, some people have ridiculed her as the "unqualified head with one eye closed". Her father, Fuuma Danjo, did not agree with the government and clashed with others, leading a rebellion in Gosha that ultimately ended in his death at the hands of young Asagi and Oboro. At the time, the protagonist, who was still a young child, was raised by his older sister, Fuuma Tokiko, who had also become the guardian of the Fuuma family. Tokiko aims to revive the Fuuma family by supporting the new head, the protagonist, but the protagonist himself is carefree and lives life on his own terms. He is afraid of upsetting Tokiko, who manages the family's assets and is both his older sister and his guardian. His hobby is reading old books that are stored at Gosha Academy, and he often skips class to read in his favorite spot.

text.ja: 独立遊撃隊隊長、ふうま小太郎だ。これからは俺もみんなと一緒に戦うぞ
text.en: I'm Fuuma Kotaro, the captain of the Independent Strike Team. From now on, I'll be fighting alongside everyone.

text.ja: たまにはゆっくり風呂に浸かりたいが……なぜかいつも邪魔が入るんだよな
text.en: I wish I could just relax in the bath for once... but somehow, I always get interrupted.

text.ja: さてと、今日は久しぶりに何の予定もないことだし、のんびり読書でも……ん？　やれやれ、アサギ校長先生から呼び出しか……
text.en: Well, since I don't have any plans for today, I think I'll just take it easy and read a book... huh? Oh no, I've been called out by Principal Asagi.

text.ja: こうして俺が暮らしていけるのも時子のおかげだ。心から感謝している。だからその、もう少し小遣いをだな……
text.en: The fact that I can live like this is all thanks to Tokiko. I'm truly grateful to her. So, I was thinking, maybe I could get a bit more allowance...

text.ja: 対魔忍の忍法については、まだ解明されていないことも多い。どうやって受け継がれ、発現するのか……
text.en: There's still a lot that's not understood about the Taimanin's ninja arts. How are they passed down, and how do they manifest?

text.ja: 過去でも未来でも、みんな世界を良くしようと頑張ってるんだな。俺も、俺が今できることを頑張らないと
text.en: Whether it's in the past or the future, everyone's working hard to make the world a better place. I need to do my part and do what I can do now.

text.ja: このところ任務続きで、全く本が読めていない。借りた本の返却期限も迫ってるっていうのに……
text.en: I've been on so many missions lately, I haven't had a chance to read any books. And the deadline to return the ones I borrowed is approaching...

text.ja: 俺が中央を走って囮になり、もう一人が敵の背後に回り込む……次はその作戦でいこう。いや、ゲームの話だ
text.en: I'll be the decoy, running through the center, while the other person sneaks up behind the enemy... yeah, that's the plan for next time. No, wait, I'm just talking about a game.
